# Breeding and Mapping-Population Validation Contract

## Simulation Truth

- Founder panel and genome build/provenance, chromosome-specific maps, cross
  design, parent identities, generations, selection rules, seed, and requested
  line count.
- Founder ancestry, parental links, recombination breakpoints, and any imposed
  distortion, introgression, missingness, or genotype-error truth.

## Required Results

- Offspring FASTA and/or VCF, sample/family metadata, ancestry TSV,
  breakpoint TSV, realized recombination-map TSV, structural-variant truth when
  requested, and a parameter manifest.

## Required Figures

- Allele-frequency distribution or trajectory.
- Founder-contribution/ancestry plot and breakpoint or segment-length plot.
- Heterozygosity/homozygosity by generation for selfing, RIL, or inbreeding.
- Donor fraction and target-tract distribution for NIL/backcross designs.
- LD decay or regional LD heatmap only when enough markers and lines exist.

## Pass Criteria

- All promised truth and genotype files exist; sample count equals the requested
  retained-line count.
- Genotypes contain only permitted ploidy-aware allele states and allele
  frequencies lie in `[0, 1]`.
- Parent, family, founder, chromosome, and breakpoint labels are non-missing
  and internally consistent.
- Repeated selfing/inbreeding should increase mean homozygosity; unselected
  donor background should decline with additional backcrosses. These are
  directional programmed checks, not universal biological laws.
- A designed low-recombination interval should have fewer breakpoints than a
  comparable high-recombination interval when the simulation map imposes that
  contrast.
